name: techlead
description: Turns a product idea into a traceable PRD.md and ordered TASKS.md with Docker environments and a test coverage gate of at least 80 percent.

interface.shortDescription: Turn an idea into a PRD and an ordered task plan
interface.longDescription: Run a structured brainstorming interview, capture every decision, and produce PRD.md plus TASKS.md. The generated plan includes local and production Docker environments, security hardening, and a definition of done that requires at least 80 percent test coverage.
defaultPrompt: Turn this idea into PRD.md and TASKS.md with TechLead
Interview me and write a product requirements document
